claim.claim-text: 1. A removable toilet bowl cover apparatus, comprising: a flexible snap-on cover monolithically formed configured to overlay a toilet seat, the cover having a top rim, a center body, and a side rim defining an opening for receiving the toilet bowl; at least one handle grip monolithically formed on the side rim configured to facilitate attachment to and removal from the toilet seat; and a plurality of ventilation holes formed through the center body and configured to permit air circulation.

2. The removable toilet bowl cover apparatus of claim 1, further comprising: at least one coating applied to an exterior surface of the snap-on cover, the at least one coating having one or more of: an antimicrobial property, or a disinfecting property.
